question: In which of the following cities was the final match of the 2022 Vijay Hazare Trophy held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ahmedabad**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The final match of the **2022 Vijay Hazare Trophy** was held in **Ahmedabad**.
 
• The **Vijay Hazare Trophy **is a **List A cricket tournament** in India, named after the legendary cricketer Vijay Hazare.
 
• The tournament is also known as the **Ranji One-Day Trophy** and is contested by state teams from the** Ranji Trophy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Vijay Hazare Trophy** was first played in the **2002-03** season.
 
• It provides an opportunity for domestic players to showcase their talent and potentially secure a place in the national team.
 
• Many prominent Indian cricketers have participated in this tournament, contributing to its prestige and popularity.
